short_description: Bihar ke apne ward ki baatein, local reviews aur events, padosiyon ke saath.
full_description:
Your neighbourhood is more than a location. It is the people, everyday conversations and small acts around you.

Bihar Local - Mohalla Charcha brings local updates, civic discussions, neighbourhood reviews, community events and general conversations into one ward-first feed.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Share a useful local observation or start a conversation.
• Highlight a civic concern and support neighbours with upvotes or “mere yahan bhi”.
• Review a local shop or service with a rating and useful details.
• Share a community event, venue and time, and RSVP.
• Add photos, reply to discussions and save posts.

YOUR WARD COMES FIRST
Urban: District → Nagar Nigam / Nagar Parishad / Nagar Panchayat → Ward.
Rural: District → Block / Prakhand → Gram Panchayat → Ward.
Start with your home ward and deliberately widen to your area or district. Same-numbered wards in different panchayats are not treated as the same place.

PEOPLE-TO-PEOPLE ONLY
This is an independent neighbour network, not a government app, official complaint portal or breaking-news service. Posts are not routed to officials or departments.

PRIVACY AND LANGUAGE
Hindi and English UI. Choose your area manually; GPS/location permission is not required. Do not post exact home addresses or private contact details. Phone verification is not residency verification.

CURRENT PREVIEW
This build uses persistent, device-local demo data, fictional example content and illustrative locations. No real SMS is sent and it is not a live shared community yet. Live backend/SMS, verified locations, moderation and launch checks must be completed before a real-user release.
